scenes.audio: What would happen if you were born as a slave in ancient Rome?
scenes.visual: Translucent glassy skeleton with large expressive eyes, loincloth, pulled by two hooded armored guards on deck of wooden sailing ship in violent storm; cold blue dramatic light; ocean spray.

scenes.audio: Day one, you wake up on a wooden ship while chained men row through rough water.
scenes.visual: Same skeleton lying distressed on deck; three muscular chained men rowing huge oars behind; handheld camera mimicking boat rocking.

scenes.audio: Guards shout as waves slam the sides and the boat rocks hard.
scenes.visual: Wide: ship in massive waves; skeleton slides across wet deck; guards struggle for footing; dark moody, saturated blue/white.

scenes.audio: When land appears, you are dragged off and counted with the others.
scenes.visual: Skeleton on pier tied to thick rope, wide-eyed; stone castle and misty harbor behind; overcast grey light.

scenes.audio: Year five, you are thrown into a training yard and told to fight older slaves.
scenes.visual: Skeleton now in brown vest and leather bracers in dusty sunlit training yard; guard with staff behind; skeleton cowers defensively.

scenes.audio: Your arms shake as wooden weapons knock you to the ground again and again.
scenes.visual: Series of quick cuts: skeleton knocked down repeatedly by wooden staff in sandy arena; fighters practicing behind; dust clouds; warm sun.

scenes.audio: You stand up every time because stopping means worse.
scenes.visual: Skeleton struggles up in sand holding chest; fatigued, bruised; wooden practice sword stuck in ground behind.

scenes.audio: Year 15, you train every day until your body reacts without thinking.
scenes.visual: Skeleton now more muscular, hand-to-hand with large human; blocks punch and counters; fast fluid motion.

scenes.audio: You block strikes, push back, and stay on your feet longer each fight.
scenes.visual: Skeleton punches stone wall, dust flies; intense focus and anger; slaves and instructors watch.

scenes.audio: Instructors stop hitting you first and start watching instead.
scenes.visual: Static shot: skeleton stands tall, looks directly into camera with menacing grin; glassy skin reflects hard sunlight.

scenes.audio: Year 25, you enter the Colosseum as gates open and noise crashes down from above.
scenes.visual: Skeleton in leather armor walks through massive stone gate into packed Colosseum; eyes glow bright orange.

scenes.audio: Sometimes animals are released, sometimes the floor is flooded and fighters struggle to stay upright.
scenes.visual: Skeleton dodges charging bull in dust; next cut: fighting gladiators on flooded arena floor, water splashing.

scenes.audio: You survive one fight, then another, then many more.
scenes.visual: Skeleton victorious center arena holding metal helmet; body scratched and grimy; cheering crowd; strong top light.

scenes.audio: Year 30, you step into the arena knowing this fight decides everything.
scenes.visual: Skeleton heavily scarred, one-shoulder metal armor, fighting stance facing off-screen opponent; glowing orange eyes.

scenes.audio: You trade blows until your opponent drops and waits for the signal.
scenes.visual: From behind skeleton looking up at balcony where emperor figure in white toga gives thumbs-up; opponent kneeling in dust.

scenes.audio: When the order comes, you act, and the crowd roars as your chains are finally removed.
scenes.visual: Skeleton stands triumphant; broken iron chains fall from wrists to sand; arms raised, crowd blurs; final close-up on smiling face, orange eye-glow intensifying.
